public_notes: Asset-pipeline rungs shipped in brender-archival (four CTest rungs total, fifteen targets): brender_core_asset_audit loads .dat models via BrModelLoad and validates vertex finiteness, face index ranges, degenerate faces, and per-face material attachment (br_face.material verified against the pinned inc/model.h); brender_core_material_audit probes period .pix files via BrPixelmapLoad with honest decode reporting; brender_core_material_file_audit loads std.mat and winstd.mat via BrMaterialLoad reporting identifier, flags, index_base, and colour_map attachment. Loader availability and struct fields were verified against the pinned v1.3.2 tree at d88d0ed4: BrModelLoad/BrMaterialLoad in core/v1db/v1dbfile.c, BrPixelmapLoad in core/pixelmap/pmfile.c; the dat/ inventory was enumerated from that tree (68 assets including earth.pix, gold8.pix, std.mat, std.pal). Deferred honestly: .pal chunk decoding (no BrPaletteLoad exists in this API), 15-bit partial decode fix, per-group validation.
